meta.interpretation: The user wants to know which drug pairs most frequently appear together in the same breast cancer trial — i.e. a drug co-occurrence network built from combination-therapy trials.
assumptions: Limited to interventional trials with Drug or Biological interventions, so device/behavioral studies are excluded.
Restricted to trials starting in 2015 or later to reflect the current treatment landscape; remove this to cover all years.
Combination trials are inferred from trials listing two or more drugs — multi-arm monotherapy comparisons will also contribute edges.
Grouped by MeSH-normalized intervention terms rather than raw sponsor-written names, to merge brand and dose variants.
Edges supported by fewer than 4 shared trials are dropped and the graph is capped at 50 highest-degree drugs for readability.
meta.counting_semantics: An edge links two drug / intervention (mesh) values that appear together in the same trial; its weight is the number of trials studying both.
